note: Minimum size equipment grounding conductor (EGC) by rating or setting of the overcurrent device ahead of the circuit, wire-type EGCs. Rows are 'not exceeding' thresholds: pick the first row whose maxOcpdA >= the OCPD rating. Aluminum column is aluminum or copper-clad aluminum. Transcribed through 1200 A (the engine's conductor range tops out at 600 kcmil; larger services are out of scope). The 30 A and 40 A rows are not printed in NEC 2011+ (the printed table jumps 20 → 60); they are kept here as explicit thresholds and carry exactly what the 60 A row yields for those ratings (10 Cu / 8 Al), so lookup behavior is identical to the print. Where the circuit conductors are upsized (e.g., for voltage drop), 250.122(B) proportional upsizing is NOT applied by the data — that is engine/application logic. Cross-verified 2026-08-16 against two full independent sources (0 mismatches): NEC 2011 full-text reproduction and a utility service-requirements reproduction, corroborated by 2020/2023 online reproductions; values unchanged 2011→2023. Official 2026 text paywalled; unchanged per change summaries. 2026 renumbering per CMP-5 Second Draft SR-8360 ('no technical changes'): the table becomes Table 250.122(A), the proportional-increase rule 250.122(B) becomes 250.122(D), and the not-larger-than-circuit-conductors cap is scoped 'in the raceway or cable'.
